name: ButtonGroup
summary: A row of joined buttons that share a single rounded outline. For segmented filters, toolbar action groups, and density toggles.

pill.description: Pill mode — first/last child get full radius. Pair with shape='pill' on the children for visual consistency.

children.description: Two or more <Button> elements. Each child renders with borderRadius=0 and -1 px margin to overlap borders.

keyboard: Tab - move focus through buttons (each button is independently focusable)
rules: Each child Button retains its own keyboard handling — do NOT swap to ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (that's the Segmented pattern).
If the group represents an exclusive choice (one option active), use Segmented instead — it ships aria-pressed handling.

do: Use for related actions (Cut / Copy / Paste).
Use ButtonGroup for non-exclusive button rows; use Segmented for exclusive single-choice rows.
dont: Don't put a primary intent next to a danger intent in a ButtonGroup — too much shared chrome.
Don't put a primary CTA inside a ButtonGroup — that's a SplitButton.

changelog.note: Formal ButtonGroup primitive. Joined buttons via -1 px overlap, focus-visible z-index lift, pill-mode optional.
